name: yummy
description: Yummy — a pastel pantry-first recipe companion, Rust-powered, on your phone.

scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.core:android: cd rust/yummy-core && cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a -t armeabi-v7a -t x86_64 -o ../../android/app/src/main/jniLibs build --release
